nb_dystopia_wall.blurb: Dystopia Wall is the nearer of the two walls at the Utopia crag in the Welsford area of New Brunswick, and it is a hard-sport venue: ten bolted lines, with three in the 5.11 range, five at 5.12 and a couple of 5.13s. Nothing here is a warm-up. The profile runs from vertical to moderately overhanging, plus a few very steep, short lines on a small wall above and to the left of the main face. The wall catches sun in the morning and falls into shade by afternoon. Expect bugs in late spring and early summer, and some seepage after wet weather. Helmets are wise, since the rock is not perfect everywhere at the crag.
nb_dystopia_wall.approach: From the parking spot, follow the dirt road to its end and pick up the flagged trail. Once in the trees, take the first left branch and climb uphill to reach the wall.
